scenes.title: Le Retour
scenes.narration: Décembre mille neuf cent quarante-quatre. Le port de Dakar. Trois tirailleurs rentrent au pays. Ils ont combattu pour la France. Leur France. Ils attendent leur solde.

Characters STAY in their positions on deck — no one walks, no one leaves frame. MAINTAIN dot-eyes throughout, pure black dot pupils, NO realistic eyes, NO visible iris, NO BD comic drift. No text, no banners.

scenes.title: La Revendication
scenes.narration: Thiaroye, camp militaire. La solde ne vient pas. Les tirailleurs s'organisent. Calmes. Dignes. Une main s'ouvre. Une demande. Rien de plus.
scenes.image_description: Intérieur caserne Thiaroye. 3 tirailleurs assis à table en bois rugueux. Au premier plan en foreground flou: épaule d'un officier français (silhouette OTS). Fenêtre à barreaux arrière, ombres indigo froides. Le tirailleur central a la main ouverte paume haute tendue vers l'officier absent. Atmosphere lived-in: un tirailleur écrit sur un papier, un autre discute avec gestes, le central tend la main. Pas de posture parade.
scenes.prompt_gemini_template:
Paper-craft scene illustration, 9:16 vertical frame.

SCENE: Interior of Thiaroye military camp, December 1944. Three Senegalese tirailleurs gathered around a rough wooden table. Foreground right: the shoulder and back of kepi of an absent French officer (blurred OTS silhouette). Barred window behind, cold indigo light filtering. The central tirailleur has his right hand open palm-up, extending toward the officer — a quiet demand.

STYLE (match style anchor):
- REF 1 (style anchor): paper-craft storybook — thick black outlines, flat color fills, paper kraft texture, rounded proportions, dot-eyes.
- REF 2 (tirailleur charref): uniform, beret, skin tone, dot-eyes.

LIFE IN THE ROOM (vivid, not posed):
- Left tirailleur: leaning forward on elbows, one hand writing on paper, other hand resting flat on table, head tilted down in concentration
- Central tirailleur: right hand open palm-up extended forward at chest level, gaze steady on the absent officer, left hand gripping his knee (tension visible)
- Right tirailleur: mid-speech, lips parted, one hand gesturing toward the central tirailleur, torso turned inward toward the group
- OTS officer silhouette (foreground right, blurred): shoulder and back of kepi, indistinct

ENVIRONMENT:
- Rough wooden table, visible grain
- Barred window back-left: cold indigo-grey light beams crossing the table
- Stone walls muted grey-beige
- Papers scattered on the table, a tin cup, a folded army jacket draped on a chair
- Uniforms retain warm khaki-olive — only warmth in the cold room

COMPOSITION ANTI-PARADE:
- Three tirailleurs staggered around the table (not in a line)
- Different head orientations and postures
- OTS officer in foreground creates depth

CRITICAL TECHNICAL RULES:
- Strict dot-eyes: single black dot, no iris, no white sclera, no eyelashes
- Flat color fills only, no hatching, no shading gradients
- Warmth comes from palette choice, not from shading
- Paper-craft Sonjata style, not semi-realistic BD
- No text, no readable writing on papers (just lines suggesting handwriting)
- 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)

scenes.title: Le Massacre — L'Ordre et le Feu
scenes.narration: Premier décembre mille neuf cent quarante-quatre. À l'aube, l'armée française ouvre le feu. Sur ses propres soldats.
scenes.image_description: Cour du camp à l'aube. Ciel gris plombé. Soldats français en arrière-plan (silhouettes paper-craft, fusils levés à l'épaule). Tirailleur sénégalais au premier plan, stoïque, debout face aux soldats — regard direct, corps ancré. Moment suspendu avant le tir.
scenes.prompt_gemini_template:
Paper-craft illustration, 9:16 vertical. SCENE: Camp Thiaroye courtyard at dawn, December 1, 1944. Grey leaden sky, cold mist crossing the ground. Background left-third: a line of French army soldiers, rifles raised to shoulder level, paper-craft flat silhouette shapes, faces suggested by dot-eyes only. Foreground right-third: one Senegalese tirailleur close to camera, facing the soldiers — upright, weight planted, gaze fixed straight at the firing line. His arms hang at his sides, fists loosely closed. Stoic. Unbroken.

STYLE: Match style anchor — paper-craft, thick black outlines, flat color fills, paper kraft texture. Strict dot-eyes on every face, including distant soldiers.

PALETTE: cold grey-plomb sky, muted khaki uniforms, grey courtyard ground, deep cold blue shadows, one subtle warm accent on a lantern at courtyard edge (dying glow).

COMPOSITION:
- Tirailleur foreground-right, three-quarter view toward the soldiers, body fully visible
- French soldiers background-left in a staggered line (not geometric), 5-6 figures, rifles raised at varying heights
- Mid-ground courtyard: empty stone-dust surface, one fallen beret hints at prior confrontation
- Cold dawn light from upper-right casts long blue shadows

LIFE IN THE SCENE (not posed):
- Tirailleur: weight committed forward on one foot, jaw set, fists loosely closed at sides — alive in his stillness
- French soldiers: not identical — one LEANS into his rifle, one glances sideways, one stands rigid, postures varied
- Wisps of breath visible in cold air from both sides

CRITICAL TECHNICAL RULES:
- Strict dot-eyes everywhere: single black dot, no iris, no white
- Flat color fills only, no hatching, no shading gradients
- No text, no banners, no readable insignia
- 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)

Across the courtyard, French soldiers SHIFT weight in their firing stance, one ADJUSTS his rifle grip, another GLANCES at the soldier next to him. Mist DRIFTS across the courtyard ground. scenes.title: Le Massacre — Plan-tableau post-tirs
scenes.narration: Sur ceux qui avaient libéré la France. La demande devient silence. Le silence devient sang.

scenes.title: L'Effacement — Les Archives
scenes.narration: Quatre-vingts morts officiels. Peut-être trois cents. Peut-être plus. Personne ne sait. Personne ne veut savoir. Les archives se ferment. Les noms s'effacent.
scenes.r_dynamic_action: main gantée qui pousse un tiroir qui se ferme sur un dossier marqué THIAROYE
scenes.image_description: Intérieur archives militaires françaises 1945. Mur de tiroirs métalliques gris. Au premier plan: main gantée noire qui pousse un tiroir à moitié fermé. Dans le tiroir visible: un dossier avec un tampon flou 'THIAROYE' (forme seulement, pas texte lisible). Palette: gris bureaucratique froid.

scenes.title: La Vérité — Biram Senghor
scenes.narration: Quatre-vingts ans plus tard, le fils d'un des trois cents de Thiaroye dépose plainte. Biram Senghor contre l'État français. En mars deux mille vingt-six, la justice tranche.
scenes.image_description: Biram Senghor (V4 validé) debout dignement au Mémorial Thiaroye. Document de plainte dans les mains. Mur de portraits noir et blanc en arrière-plan qui COMMENCENT à s'illuminer un par un en couleurs panafricaines (vert, jaune, rouge) progressif au long du clip.
scenes.prompt_gemini_template:
Paper-craft illustration, 9:16 vertical. SCENE: Biram Senghor at the Thiaroye Memorial, 2026. Elderly Senegalese man in a dark sober suit, holding a folded legal document in both hands at chest level — his grip firm, weight committed forward.

BACKGROUND: a wall of black-and-white portrait photographs in an irregular grid (7-10 frames, varying sizes). Faces in the portraits are paper-craft silhouettes with dot-eyes — the tirailleurs of Thiaroye. Portraits are all in muted grey-black tones (no color blooming — handled in post).

STYLE: Match style anchor + Biram V4 charref. Paper-craft, thick black outlines, flat color fills, paper kraft texture. Strict dot-eyes on Biram.

PALETTE: cold overcast memorial lighting. Biram in dark navy suit. Portrait wall in muted grey-black. A small eternal flame burns at bottom-right of frame — the only warm accent.

COMPOSITION:
- Biram center-left, three-quarter view toward the portraits
- Portrait wall fills right two-thirds of background
- Cold light from upper left
- Eternal flame small flicker shape at bottom-right

LIFE IN THE SCENE (R-DYNAMIC):
- Biram: thumb pressing document edge, torso leaning slightly forward
- Portrait silhouettes: heads at varied angles (profile, frontal)
- Eternal flame: flickering shape

CRITICAL TECHNICAL RULES:
- Strict dot-eyes on Biram: single black dot, no iris, no white, no tears
- Flat color fills only, no hatching, no gradients
- No readable text on document, no readable names on portraits
- Match Biram V4 charref precisely
- 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)
scenes.prompt_seedance_template:
Animate this exact illustration. STRICT STYLE FIDELITY: flat 2D paper-craft, cold memorial palette, thick outlines, flat color fills, paper texture.

Camera: slow dolly-in toward Biram across 10 seconds, barely perceptible forward push.

SECONDS 0 TO 3: Biram's hands TIGHTEN on the document. His thumb PRESSES the paper edge. His gaze LIFTS from the document to the portrait wall. His shoulders SQUARE, chin LIFTS. The eternal flame FLICKERS at frame edge.

SECONDS 3 TO 7: Biram's head TURNS toward the portraits. His jaw SETS. His grip ADJUSTS — fingers re-settling. His torso LEANS forward slightly. The eternal flame continues to FLICKER.

SECONDS 7 TO 10: Biram's shoulders LIFT with a deep breath, SETTLE. His hands HOLD the document, one finger TAPPING the cover once. Dust motes DRIFT through the cold memorial light.

Continuous throughout: Eternal flame FLICKERS. Cold memorial light HOLDS steady. Dust motes DRIFT. Body continuously micro-shifting.

MAINTAIN strict dot-eyes throughout, pure black dot pupils, no moist eyes, no tears. No BD comic drift. No text, no banners.

Ambient: memorial silence, faint wind, distant birds, no dialogue, no music.

scenes.title: La Vérité — Le Nom sur la Pierre
scenes.narration: L'État dissimule. Le tribunal le dit. Un seul nom sur la pierre. Les autres attendent encore.
scenes.image_description: Extrême macro zoom sur le mur du Mémorial. Un seul nom gravé dans la pierre révélé au centre. Autour, d'autres noms à peine visibles (flou de profondeur). Couleurs panafricaines reflétées sur la pierre.
scenes.prompt_gemini_template:
Paper-craft illustration, 9:16 vertical. SCENE: Macro close-up of a stone memorial wall. Center of frame: a single engraved name — letter silhouettes only, no readable text. Sharp engraving, shadow line inside the letters (flat dark aplat).

Around the center: 4-5 blurred engraving silhouettes suggesting other names — just shapes, no detail.

STYLE: paper-craft on stone — flat color fills (cool grey-beige stone), paper-kraft texture, thick dark outlines around engraved recesses.

PALETTE: cool grey-beige stone. Raking cold light from the left casting long shadows inside the engravings. No color reflections on the stone — clean and stark.

COMPOSITION:
- Central engraved name: sharp, centered
- Surrounding names: blurred shapes at varying distances
- Lower-left corner: a single dried leaf resting on the stone ledge (paper-craft flat shape, dark brown)
- No other objects

CRITICAL TECHNICAL RULES:
- NO readable text — just engraving silhouettes
- Flat color fills only, no hatching, no gradients
- 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)
scenes.prompt_seedance_template:
Animate this exact illustration. STRICT STYLE FIDELITY: flat 2D paper-craft stone surface, thick outlines, flat color fills.

Camera: slow push-in toward the center engraved name across 7 seconds.

SECONDS 0 TO 3: Camera pushes forward. The center engraved name GROWS in frame. The dried leaf in the corner LIFTS in a breath of wind, SLIDES a few millimeters across the stone, SETTLES.

SECONDS 3 TO 6: Camera continues push-in. The surrounding blurred engravings RECEDE to the frame edges. Cold raking light SHIFTS slightly, deepening the shadows inside the central engraving.

SECONDS 6 TO 7: Hold on the engraved name. Light HOLDS. Leaf rests still. The stone breathes in silence.

MAINTAIN paper-craft style — flat fills, thick outlines, no photoreal drift. No text readable.

scenes.title: Le Souvenir / CTA
scenes.narration: Ils ont libéré un continent qui les oublie. Maintenant, toi, tu sais. Chaque matin dans notre newsletter, l'Afrique qu'on ne t'apprend pas. Lien en bio.
scenes.image_description: Côte de Dakar, coucher de soleil. Jeune Sénégalais debout au bord de l'eau, dos à la caméra, regard vers l'horizon. Palette pleine restaurée (or, indigo, terre rouge). Posture en écho aux tirailleurs du Clip 1. Vagues, vent dans les vêtements, oiseaux qui glissent dans le ciel.
scenes.prompt_gemini_template:
Paper-craft illustration, 9:16 vertical. SCENE: Dakar coast at sunset, present day. A young Senegalese man (20s) stands at the water's edge, BACK TO CAMERA, gaze toward the horizon. His posture echoes the tirailleurs from Scene 1 — dignified, weight committed, feet planted but alive. He wears simple modern clothes (an open jacket over a light shirt, rolled-up jeans).

STYLE: Match style anchor + Biram/jeune-temoin charref V4 consistency. Paper-craft, thick black outlines, flat color fills, paper kraft texture. Strict dot-eyes style (not visible from behind, but applied on any visible face).

PALETTE: RESTORED full warm palette — golden sunset sky (warm orange to deep indigo gradient at the top), warm red-ochre earth at his feet, deep ocean blue-green, silver highlights on the water. For the first time in the film, warmth returns. The young generation inherits.

COMPOSITION:
- Jeune temoin center-foreground, back to camera, three-quarter back view
- Ocean mid-ground filling horizontal band across the frame
- Sun low on the horizon, its reflection a warm vertical strip on the water
- Sky background occupies upper two-thirds — gradient sunset
- A few small personal objects at his feet on the sand: an old photograph (face down), a small shell
- 2-3 bird silhouettes already in the sky background

LIFE IN THE SCENE (R-DYNAMIC — multiple anchors):
- The young man: shirt collar caught by wind (hem lifting), hair tousled by the wind, one foot forward, weight committed
- Waves lapping at the shoreline (paper-craft flat ripple lines)
- Wind in his clothing (visible billow)
- Birds in the sky
- A small piece of driftwood on the shore
- A kite shape or fishing pirogue sail tiny in the far distance

CRITICAL TECHNICAL RULES:
- Flat color fills only, no hatching, no shading gradients
- Warmth comes from palette choice, not from shading
- No text visible anywhere (no shop signs, no photo text, no captions)
- 9:16 vertical (1080x1920)
scenes.prompt_seedance_template:
Animate this exact illustration. STRICT STYLE FIDELITY: flat 2D paper-craft, warm restored palette (golden sunset, deep indigo, red-ochre earth, ocean blue-green), thick outlines, flat color fills, paper texture.

Camera: dolly-out across 10 seconds combined with tilt-up toward the sunset sky.

SECONDS 0 TO 3: The young man stands at the water's edge, back to camera. His shirt collar LIFTS in the wind, jacket hem BILLOWS outward. His hair STIRS. His weight SHIFTS from one foot to the other. Waves LAP at the shore in paper-craft ripples, one wave CLIMBS higher onto the sand near his feet, RECEDES. Two bird silhouettes GLIDE across the sky, left to right.

SECONDS 3 TO 7: Camera begins the dolly-out. The young man LIFTS his right hand and HOLDS it outstretched toward the horizon — a silent salute to the sea. His hand HOLDS for a beat, then LOWERS to his side. He TURNS his head toward the photograph at his feet, then TURNS back to the horizon. A third bird silhouette CROSSES the sky. The distant pirogue sail TILTS with the wind.

SECONDS 7 TO 10: Camera tilts up toward the golden sunset sky. The young man RECEDES in frame as we pull back. The sky FILLS more of the frame — golden, warm, open. The photograph at his feet FLUTTERS, one edge LIFTS in the wind. Another bird silhouette JOINS the others. Wind CARRIES a light spray from the waves across the sand.

Continuous throughout: Waves LAP at the shore. Wind BILLOWS his clothing, LIFTS his hair. Birds GLIDE across the sky. Sky gradient WARMS progressively toward the horizon. Sand TRAILS caught by the wind drift across the frame.

All elements stay engaged, scene continuously breathing. MAINTAIN paper-craft style, flat fills, no realism drift. No text, no banners.

Ambient: ocean waves, distant gulls, wind, no dialogue, no music.

(4) Geste hand: outstretched salute clair (pas 'briefly raises') - 3s de durée, action lisible. (5) Turn head + turn back = vie organique R-DYNAMIC v2. (6) Charref V4 jeune-temoin consistency signalée. (7) Palette warm restoration documentée: 5 tons chauds (golden sky, orange-indigo gradient, red-ochre earth, ocean blue-green, silver water highlights).
